p1_findings.title: shape product can wrap to zero
p1_findings.evidence: shape [2^32,1,2^32,1,1] is individually positive and integral, but np.int64 product wraps to zero; validate_bitpack then admits an empty file as a zero-element payload
p1_findings.impact: an impossible manifest shape can bypass byte-length and tail validation, violating fail-closed payload identity
p1_findings.repair: compute the product with Python arbitrary-precision integers, reject bool dimensions, impose explicit per-dimension and total-element bounds, and check the product before any NumPy cast

p1_findings.title: parent-directory symlink escapes the manifest package
p1_findings.evidence: a lexically relative alias/x path whose alias parent is a symlink is accepted; only a symlink at the leaf itself is rejected
p1_findings.impact: a sealed manifest can resolve and consume bytes outside its sealed package root
p1_findings.repair: resolve both package root and candidate path, require candidate.relative_to(root.resolve()), and reject symlinks on every path component before hashing/reading

p1_findings.title: route is not bound to its manifest container and decoder module
p1_findings.evidence: d0_d2_d3_binary_records accepts an EXACT_SCALED_BINARY_BITPACK row for module_index 3 and consumes theta_binary_candidate
p1_findings.impact: a structurally valid but semantically misrouted decoder record can enter workload mapping
p1_findings.repair: enforce D0/D2/D3 list => modules {0,2,3} plus EXACT_BINARY_BITPACK and row.input; enforce D1 list => module 1 plus EXACT_SCALED_BINARY_BITPACK and theta_binary_candidate; reject all cross-list combinations

p2_findings.title: boolean values pass selected integer gates
p2_findings.evidence: tile_m=True, phases=(True,), and output_channels=True are accepted
p2_findings.repair: use type(value) is int or an explicit non-bool integral validator consistently

positive_findings: fresh non-square NumPy reconstruction exactly matches a separately built PyTorch ConvTranspose2d oracle for all three seeds
four phase banks, nine taps, channel-minor K ordering, all destinations, and top/left/bottom/right/interior boundary cases are exact
little-bit interpretation, tail padding, shape/spec/weight-layout drift, lexical traversal, leaf symlink, duplicate JSON key, duplicate record, and tile-tail attacks otherwise fail closed
source-popcount, active-tap, and output-channel product conservation close exactly
the mapper and contract make no cycle, speedup, energy, PPA, or DATE-headline claim

authorization.only_allowed_next_action: repair all three P1 findings under new mapper/test/contract hashes, issue a new double-sealed author handoff, then request a fresh independent hammer
